change.title: stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields

source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses stripe-node 20.4.1 with apiVersion pinned to 2026-02-25.clover in src/lib/stripe.ts. Nothing breaks today because the explicit pin keeps the repo on clover. Moving to the current SDK (23.0.0, which pins 2026-09-30.endive) crosses three majors (21, 22, 23) and two API majors (dahlia, endive). That move needs one coherent PR with these edits:
- Bump the stripe package to 23 and change the pinned apiVersion to endive.
- Switch client construction to `new Stripe()`.
- Remove payment_method_types from the Checkout Session create call; endive rejects it.
- Re-typecheck the subscription and webhook handling against the reworked types and Stripe.Decimal fields.

Things to verify:
- Webhook endpoint version: the webhook endpoint's API version in the Dashboard may differ from the SDK pin. Event payload shapes follow the endpoint version, so confirm the subscription and checkout fields read in webhook/route.ts still exist.
- Stripe.js: there are no Stripe.js call sites in the usage map. If @stripe/stripe-js is actually used client-side, check it separately.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23 pins 2026-09-30.endive. The bump includes changing the apiVersion in src/lib/stripe.ts:8 from 2026-02-25.clover to 2026-09-30.endive, so the API-version move is the same edit.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. create-checkout/route.ts:39 passes payment_method_types to checkout.sessions.create. It only breaks once the repo runs on endive, so removing the parameter belongs in this upgrade PR (rely on dynamic payment methods from the Dashboard).
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. This is an intermediate major crossed on the way from 20.4.1 to 23. The Stripe import becomes a true ES6 class, so src/lib/stripe.ts must construct the client with `new Stripe(...)`. Types were also reworked, so typecheck every Stripe call.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. This is an intermediate major crossed on the way to 23. It pins dahlia, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal (check any price or amount fields read from subscriptions.retrieve), and using the wrong webhook parsing method now throws. constructEvent is still correct for snapshot events.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. Dahlia's breaking changes are crossed when jumping from clover to endive. Of those listed, the repo uses none (ui_mode, events_from and Capabilities are not used), so they are verified within this same upgrade.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"

callSites.why: Pinned apiVersion 2026-02-25.clover must change to 2026-09-30.endive to match stripe-node 23 types. The client constructor must use `new Stripe()` (node 22 ES6 class).
Passes payment_method_types to checkout.sessions.create. On endive this parameter is removed and the call would fail, so it must be dropped.

webhooks.constructEvent is unchanged but should be verified. Node 21 throws if the wrong parsing method is used for the event type, and node 23 removed constructEventWithoutVerification (not used here).
subscriptions.retrieve response types changed across 21/22/23 (decimal_string to Stripe.Decimal, reworked types). Check the fields read from the subscription.
Same as line 58: subscriptions.retrieve response shape and types change with the SDK major.
billingPortal.sessions.create needs no known breaking change, but it must still typecheck under the reworked node 22/23 types.

## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Verified]

### Change

Upgraded stripe 20.4.1 to 23.0.0 with pnpm. Pinned apiVersion 2026-09-30.endive in src/lib/stripe.ts and create-checkout/route.ts. Removed payment_method_types from the Checkout Session create call. The webhook now reads period start and end from items.data[0], and gets the invoice subscription from invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription. The new helpers are in src/lib/stripe-period.mjs. Typecheck, build and tests pass, including the new tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs. The client was already built with `new Stripe()`. The repo does not use constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType or V2List.

Files touched:
- `package.json`
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`
- `src/app/api/stripe/create-checkout/route.ts`
- `src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts`
- `src/lib/stripe-period.mjs`
- `src/lib/stripe.ts`
- `tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs`

### Why

v23 pins the endive API version and types. Endive removes payment_method_types from Checkout. Since API basil, subscription current_period_* and invoice.subscription no longer exist, so the old `as any` reads would have produced Invalid Date and thrown at runtime.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| test | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-migration | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-migration, added by the agent: `export NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL='http://localhost:3000' NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='https://placeholder.supabase.co' NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY='placeholder' SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY='placeholder' GROQ_API_KEY='placeholder' NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='pk_test_placeholder' STRIPE_SECRET_KEY='sk_test_placeholder' STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET='whsec_placeholder' NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PRICE_ID='price_placeholder' STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY='price_placeholder' STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_ANNUAL='price_placeholder' ADMIN_EMAIL='admin@example.com' CRON_SECRET='placeholder'; node --test tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (POST /v1/checkout/sessions params checked against the endive spec: no problems)

Prepared before the baseline:
- Checks ran with placeholder env: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PRICE_ID, STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY, STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_ANNUAL, ADMIN_EMAIL, CRON_SECRET.

Test of this change: `stripe-migration`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Webhook handling at endive response shapes was not run against live events.
- The Dashboard webhook endpoint API version was not checked.
- The deploy runtime was not checked for Node >=20, which stripe 23 requires.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout no longer restricts payment methods to card, so customers see whichever methods are enabled in the Dashboard.
- The subscription period is read from items.data[0], which assumes single-item subscriptions.
- If the subscription period end is missing, the invoice.payment_succeeded handler now leaves the stored current_period_end unchanged.
- invoice.payment_succeeded and invoice.payment_failed now find the subscription via invoice.parent.subscription_details. Previously they read invoice.subscription, which endive no longer sends.
- Please align the Dashboard webhook endpoint's API version to endive.

---

review.summary: The removed APIs named in the changelog (constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType, V2List V1-only fields) are not used anywhere in the files shown, so the forced part of this migration is the SDK bump and the apiVersion pin in src/lib/stripe.ts and create-checkout/route.ts. The diff goes further than that. It drops payment_method_types from Checkout, which changes which payment methods customers see. It also rewrites webhook parsing to read period fields from subscription items and the invoice subscription from parent.subscription_details. That rewrite fixes a real latent bug: on clover, `(sub as any).current_period_end` is undefined, so `new Date(NaN).toISOString()` throws. But it now depends on the webhook endpoint's own API version, which this PR cannot see. The stripe-migration check is a test the agent wrote, mostly regexes and pure helper tests. It does not exercise real webhook payloads or a live Checkout session. A 'verified' grade overstates what was proven given these behaviour changes.

concerns.issue: Line ~41: `payment_method_types: ["card"]` was removed. Nothing in the quoted changelog requires this. Without it, Checkout falls back to dashboard-configured dynamic payment methods (Link, wallets, possibly bank debits), which changes what customers see. Delayed-notification methods can also change subscription and webhook timing (e.g. checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, which is not handled). This is a product decision and should not ship silently in an SDK bump.

invoiceSubscriptionId only reads `invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription`, and the test asserts that the legacy `invoice.subscription` shape returns undefined. Webhook payload shape follows the webhook endpoint's API version set in the Stripe Dashboard, not the SDK's apiVersion pin. If the endpoint is still on a pre-basil version, invoice.payment_succeeded and invoice.payment_failed will silently do nothing. That means past_due status would never be recorded. The same applies to period fields on subscription events.

customer.subscription.updated now upserts `current_period_end`/`current_period_start` as null when items.data[0] lacks period fields. Previously it threw and returned 500, so Stripe retried. A null may now overwrite a valid stored value with no error. The payment_succeeded path guards against this with a conditional spread, but subscription.updated does not. The helpers also assume single-item subscriptions.

Helpers are imported from an untyped .mjs file, so `toIso`/`subPeriodEnd` return `any`. A passing typecheck therefore says little about the field paths. Consider a typed .ts helper using Stripe.Subscription and Stripe.Invoice so tsc validates `items.data[0].current_period_end` and `parent.subscription_details` against the v23 types.

I could not confirm `2026-09-30.endive` from memory. The changelog says v23 pins it, and typecheck passing suggests the SDK's ApiVersion literal type accepts it. Check node_modules/stripe/types (apiVersion) and Stripe's upgrade notes for endive-specific breaking changes beyond the SDK changelog line quoted.
stripe 23 requires node >=20 (it was >=16). Confirm the deployment runtime (e.g. Vercel project Node version) is 20+.

The test asserts source text by regex and reads node_modules/stripe/package.json, which is brittle. It never feeds a real endive (or older) webhook fixture through route.ts, so webhook handling is untested.
